finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry to `CHANGELOG.md`.**

Out of 380 commits, one `feat` and 28 `fix` commits were user-facing, consolidated to 10 fixed bullets since many titles repeated across modules (same bug, fixed separately in queue/api/webhooks/db, etc). No breaking changes.

One fix worth flagging: `fix(db): stop logging the whole request body` — that sounds like it may have been logging sensitive data. Worth a sentence to your team even if it stays out of public notes.

No breaking-change commits found, so that heading is omitted, matching the 4.0.3 precedent in the file. Ready for review before the cut.
